headlines.headline: Stocks to watch, Oct 22: Persistent Systems, Eternal, IHCL, PC Jeweller, Swiggy, RIL, oil-sensitives, Havells India
headlines.summary: Oil-sensitives such as ONGC, Oil India, Reliance Industries, and upstream oil producers may remain in focus as crude oil prices rose on Thursday amid escalating geopolitical tensions in the Middle East.

headlines.headline: Top gainers and losers, October 21: Bajaj Finance, BSE shares drop 3%; Infosys, HCLTech gain 3%
headlines.summary: On October 21, the SENSEX ended at 73,709.69, reflecting a 143.21-point or 0.19% decline, while the NIFTY50 closed lower by 77.60 points or 0.34% at 22,811.35.

headlines.headline: SENSEX, NIFTY50 fall for second straight session as surging crude dents sentiment
headlines.summary: The SENSEX fell as much as 1,453 points from the day's highest level and NIFTY50 index touched an intraday low of 22,650 after hitting a high of 23,120 earlier in the session.

headlines.headline: Infosys, Wipro: IT stocks steal the show as Nifty IT jumps 3% against market trend; what’s driving the rally?
headlines.summary: Indian IT stocks have found favour with investors amid encouraging Q2 FY27 earnings, healthy deal wins and optimistic management commentary from companies such as TCS, HCLTech and Wipro, as well as peers including Tata Elxsi and L&T Technology Services (LTTS).

headlines.headline: SENSEX, NIFTY erase early gains, tumble nearly 1% in noon deals: RIL, LLTS, HFCL among buzzing stocks
headlines.summary: LTTS shares jumped as much as 14.7% to touch the session’s peak of ₹4,143 apiece on the NSE on Wednesday, October 21, as it posted a 66.8% YoY increase in its consolidated net profit to ₹548.2 crore in Q2 FY27, as against ₹328.7 crore in the year-ago period.

headlines.headline: Rubio says India can refine more Venezuelan crude, to discuss opportunities with Reliance
headlines.summary: Rubio planned to discuss potential energy cooperation, including opportunities for Reliance to process Venezuelan heavy crude and explore investment options.

headlines.headline: Jio Platforms IPO: RIL shares climb 2.7% as India’s biggest issue opens; key details explained
headlines.summary: The IPO marks a significant milestone for both the company and India's capital markets, as it is the country's largest public offering to date.

headlines.headline: SBI flags 3,897 customer records containing personal information on dark web
headlines.summary: The exposed information reportedly included names, mobile numbers, dates of birth, email and residential addresses, branch and customer information file (CIF) identifiers, and loan-related metadata.

headlines.headline: SENSEX surges over 800 points, NIFTY50 reclaims 23,100 led by gains in Reliance, Infosys, TCS
headlines.summary: Infosys, Tata Consultancy Services, Reliance Industries, ICICI Bank, Bharti Airtel, Larsen & Toubro and HCL Technologies were top movers in the SENSEX.

headlines.headline: Stocks to watch, Oct 21: PC Jeweller, RIL, Bajaj Finance, Schaeffler India, oil-sensitives, IHCL, SRF, HZL
headlines.summary: Shares of oil marketing companies (OMCs), aviation companies and paint manufacturers will be in focus on Wednesday as crude oil prices remain elevated amid concerns over supply disruptions in the Middle East and risks to shipping through the region.

headlines.headline: Top gainers and losers, October 19: Axis Bank tumbles 4%, TMPV, Infosys fall 3%, JSW Steel rises 2%
headlines.summary: On October 19, the SENSEX declined by 876.38 points or 1.17% to close at 73,852.90, while the NIFTY50 ended at 22,888.95, down by 257.20 points or 1.11%.

headlines.headline: Reliance shares are down 26% this year. What could turn them around?
headlines.summary: Reliance Industries, one of the heaviest stocks in India's benchmark indices, hit a 52-week low on 13 October. A slowdown in retail, delayed telecom tariff hikes and fuel-export uncertainty have weighed on it all year. The next two weeks bring Q2 results, Jio's listing and a possible tariff hike. Could any of these turn the stock around?

headlines.headline: SENSEX, NIFTY50 snap two-day winning streak dragged by HDFC Bank, Axis Bank
headlines.summary: The SENSEX fell as much as 1,021 points and NIFTY50 index touched an intraday low of 22,845 dragged down by losses in HDFC Bank, Axis Bank, ICICI Bank, Infosys and Bharti Airtel.

headlines.headline: Ixigo, PNB, HFCL, L&T among buzzing stocks: SENSEX falls over 1,000 pts from day’s high, NIFTY below 22,900
headlines.summary: Shares of Punjab National Bank (PNB) gained as much as 7.7% to hit an intraday high of ₹125.22 per equity share on October 19, as it saw its standalone net profit rise 12.8% YoY to ₹5,532 crore in the second quarter of FY27.

headlines.headline: FMCG stocks struggle: NIFTY FMCG index down 18% in 2026; why a margin recovery looks elusive
headlines.summary: Latest industry reports said that FMCG companies face sustained margin pressure in the second half of the current fiscal year (H2 FY27) as rising input costs squeeze profitability, with firms weighing post-Diwali price hikes against the risk of hurting consumer demand, particularly in price-sensitive mass-market and rural categories.
